text:
maya: Quick sweep — where are we on onboarding tamarind-7b, cedar-13b, and azul-30b? Need owners, license status, perf profiles, and a canary window by EOW. cc: @lina @chris

lina: Tamarind-7b -> owner: lina. License looks permissive (MIT-ish) but we need confirmation on dataset provenance from the upstream author. Perf PR drafted: PR #4281.

chris: Cedar-13b -> owner: chris. Vendor license OK but uses a proprietary tokenizer; we'll need to compile tokenizer as part of the runtime image. I'll open the runtime PR today.

devex: devex: tracking PRs — tamarind PR #4281, cedar runtime PR #4289, azul quant PR #4295. Adding labels: model-onboard, perf-needed.

tom: Azul-30b perf snapshot from staging: ~28 ms/token on A10G, about 5% worse than our target. int8 quant helps cost but slightly degrades quality on LlamaEval set. I'll run the full eval suite tonight. :mag:

maya: Can teams post perf profiles + baseline eval by tomorrow noon? Also what’s legal signoff ETA (@sasha)?

sasha: Sasha: Legal looked at the tamarind license notes — we need author confirmation for CC0 subsets included in training. I sent a quick template email to the contact; if they reply today, ETA ~48h. Otherwise will need a scoped mitigation for launch.

oliver: Infra check: we have reserved capacity for the canary (2 p4d-ish nodes equivalent). Suggested runtime config: batch_size=8, kv_cache=enabled, prefetch=2. Which variants should we route to first?

chris: Routing plan idea: primary = fp16 Azul, secondary = fp16 Tamarind, fallback = int8 Cedar, emergency = hosted-small. Will add these to rollout config and PR the routing policy.

lina: Note: PR #4281 needs one more review from @oliver (runtime packaging) and @sasha (license blurb).

oliver: Reviewing today, should be able to approve EOD.

maya: :thumbsup: I'll collate outcomes into the launch checklist. Quick ask — anyone blocking the model cards for the console? @devex

devex: devex: I’ll draft the model cards once we have merged perf numbers and the final license text. Please paste the final perf table here when ready.

tom: Putting initial perf table here:
```
model,tokens/ms,latency(ms)
Tamarind-7b,0.035,120
Cedar-13b,0.028,230
Azul-30b,0.033,300
```

maya: Thanks — last note: tentative canary window Friday 10:00–14:00 UTC if legal clears. If anyone cannot support that window, reply here. Otherwise I'll lock and notify infra + oncall. :calendar:
